"""Compute count, mean, and median of the numbers in data.txt and write them to stats.txt."""

from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean, median

INPUT_PATH = Path("data.txt")
OUTPUT_PATH = Path("stats.txt")


def parse_number(line):
    value = float(line)
    return int(value) if value.is_integer() else value


def main():
    numbers = [parse_number(line) for line in INPUT_PATH.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if not numbers:
        raise SystemExit(f"no numbers found in {INPUT_PATH}")

    OUTPUT_PATH.write_text(
        f"count: {len(numbers)}\n"
        f"mean: {mean(numbers):g}\n"
        f"median: {median(numbers):g}\n"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
